reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading is accurate: get_data_column_sidecars lacks validation that cellsAndProofs.len equals blob_kzg_commitments.len (lines 274-276 iterate over cellsAndProofs.len while line 281 assigns all commitments). However, this is a code-intrinsic deviation, not attacker-triggered. The function is an internal construction helper operating on locally-produced data: cellsAndProofs comes from computeCellsAndKzgProofs(blob) in the block production flow, and blob_kzg_commitments comes from the local block body. An attacker cannot directly cause the length mismatch; it would only occur due to local code bugs in blob processing. This is a correctness bug (should have defensive validation per spec SG-003 line 22: 'INV: len(cells_and_kzg_proofs) == len(kzg_commitments) (precondition)'), not a security vulnerability. The construction path is semi-trusted (EL-CL Engine API boundary), not an untrusted external input path. Spec reference: 01e_PARTIAL_W3B4_1771748827.json, property PROP-57888860-pre-007, invariant 'cells_and_kzg_proofs length must equal kzg_commitments length before sidecar construction.' Attacker control: none. Path type: code-intrinsic. The deviation is caused by the code's own assembly logic, not by attacker input values.
